race.comment: SPIRITED DEFENCE (1) looks well placed. The fresh win here was dominant, bringing his record here to 4 wins from 6 starts including 4/5 over this route. He went over to Pakenham Synthetic last time in tougher company and was solid but back to his home deck here he should bounce right back. MISS MAHJONG (6) just found one better last time at this track behind a handy horse in Audio Pop Cam. She should take holding out late. CHARMING NIC (4) resumes off a long break. He's certainly good enough to win this on his day and the late betting will be the key. SHAALUTE (3) was good at Pakenham Synthetic last time, beating home SPIRITED DEFENCE. He's another that likes it here and should be right there. POWERBOUND (5) next best.
